name: Benton
intro: Saline County has quietly become one of my favorite corners of Central Arkansas to film. The Venue at Stonebrook Meadows in Bauxite — minutes from both Benton and Bryant — has given me two weddings and what might be the single best golden hour of any venue I shoot, that massive window wall filling the reception with light as the sun drops behind 41 acres of rolling countryside. Days like those are why Benton and Bryant couples don't need to look toward Little Rock to find a wedding worth filming.

The best part for couples out here: you're squarely inside my coverage area. I'm based in Little Rock, fifteen-some minutes up the interstate, which means no travel fee, no logistics headaches, and a videographer who can scout your venue or meet you for coffee without it being an event. Whether your day is at Stonebrook, a family church in Benton, or a backyard in Bryant with a tent and string lights, I film Saline County weddings the same way I film everywhere — like the day matters, because it does.

faqs.question: Do you charge a travel fee to Benton or Bryant?
faqs.answer: No — Benton, Bryant, and Bauxite are all well inside my 50-mile radius from Little Rock. Travel is completely included, with no fees and no fine print.

faqs.question: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.answer: Popular Saturdays book nine to twelve months out, and I take one wedding per date, always. A retainer holds your date; payment plans cover the rest before the wedding.

faqs.question: When will we get our films?
faqs.answer: Your Instagram reel arrives within 48 hours. Your full film comes by a guaranteed delivery date, written into your contract — you'll know the date before you book.
